title: Hand-painted
description: Soft brushed painting with visible brush texture, rich colour variation and soft edges.

art_style.outline_policy: No hard outline; edges come from colour and value contrast.
art_style.shading_policy: Soft painted light and shadow with colour-temperature shifts.
art_style.texture_policy: Visible brush texture kept at one consistent scale.

native_size_guidance: Draw at about twice the final display size and reduce once with a smooth filter; keep every asset in a set at the same scale.
avoid: Do not add hard black outlines.
Do not mix brush scales within one set.
Do not bake cast shadows into sprites that move.
